layoutExtraction.prompt: Precise layout edit of this photographic four-pose contact sheet. Preserve every person's identity, realistic photographic texture, expression, wardrobe and exact pose. Scale each of the FOUR bodies down by 18 percent, independently around the CENTER OF ITS OWN QUADRANT, creating a large empty transparent safety margin around each whole person. The resulting image must be a strict 2-column, 2-row atlas: all pixels of each person, including feet, must lie within x=5%-45% or x=55%-95% of width and y=5%-43% or y=57%-95% of height. In particular top-row shoes must be comfortably ABOVE the middle horizontal line, and bottom-row heads BELOW it. Remove all backdrop gradients, haze and glows; every empty pixel fully transparent alpha=0. No body, hand, head or foot may overlap a quadrant boundary. Do not redraw in cartoon style. Preserve photographic realism.
